newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums unchanged, demand slack.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums unchanged, demand slack.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were unchanged in slow volumes on Wednesday, traders said.
Feb IPE gas oil futures were $1 down at $212.75 a tonne on NYMEX selling of heating oil and WTI crude contracts.

Barges were seen notionally around Feb +$30/31 fob ARA. Fob cargoes remained around Feb IPE +$25/26 fob ARA in light discussion. A 10,000 tonne cargo of Russian kerosene was done into Oslo at mean quotes flat.
Most north European shorts are expected to postpone prospective business into February, traders said.
